_hosts_comment: Hostnames or addresses passed to ping; every target is measured independently.
_interval_comment: Seconds between ping samples per target.
_seconds_per_column_comment: Seconds represented by one graph column; 0 chooses from the pane width and retained window.
_window_comment: Seconds of readings retained for statistics and graphs.
_spike_factor_comment: How many times above the recent baseline marks a latency spike.
_aggregate_comment: How several samples in one graph column are combined.
_strip_suffixes_comment: Hostname suffixes removed from on-screen labels only.
